key.name: terminal-transparent
key.summary: Use a translucent GNOME Terminal background
key.description: Writes a scoped GTK 3 style. Restart Terminal to apply. Other terminal applications are not affected.

key.name: new-window-on-launch
key.summary: Always open a new window when launching an application
key.description: App icons in search, the dash and the app grid request a new window for running applications that support it. Turn off to focus an existing window instead.

key.name: panel-enabled
key.summary: Transparent adaptive panel with centered numbered workspaces

key.name: gap
key.summary: Space between windows in logical pixels

key.name: split-mode
key.summary: Split along the longest side, side by side, or stacked

key.name: restore-on-disable
key.summary: Restore window sizes when tiling is switched off
